D1_test_card_layout_meaningful.detail: test_card_layout checks (a) card.visible and c.size.x>0 and not c.intersects(hud_rect) — on old code card was at (0,0,153x131) which intersects hud (0,0,387x390) → would fail; (b) card is inside viewport and StyleBoxFlat bg_color.a >= 0.9 — old code had no StyleBoxFlat → would throw null deref / fail. Controller measured RED 41/2 on old arrival_card.gd, consistent with 2 new checks. Threshold 0.9 < 0.96 (correct: tests a minimum opacity, not the exact value).

F1_test_settle_meaningful.detail: Mutation 'for r in refused' → 'for r in []' applied to bridge/transit.gd; make transit-test run. Result: 42 passed, 1 failure ('settle: a refusal at the pending intent's index keeps the old warp level'). Warp incorrectly advanced to 0.05 instead of remaining at WARP_DEFAULT. Restored via git checkout -- bridge/transit.gd; line confirmed restored. The test is meaningful and catches the refusal-ignored bug.

F1_mutation_count_discrepancy.detail: Executor notes claim '3 failures' for this mutation; actual result is 1. The second test_settle check (positive path) passes even with the mutation because an empty refused list still yields not turned_down → warp = _pending = 0.05, which is what that case expects. No transit-harness replay checks were affected (no warp intents appear to be refused by the sim in that run). The discrepancy is in the sprint notes only; the test code is correct and catches the fault.
